title: Shared Xtream field types
description: Field types shared by every player_api.php action. They follow the PHP-panel types of SPEC §7.5: identifiers clients do arithmetic on are integers, everything else (timestamps, counts, ports, category ids, flags) is a decimal string, and a missing value is "", never null. Patterns are anchored and use ECMA-262 syntax.

text.description: Free text. "" when unknown, never null.

alwaysEmpty.description: Always "" (custom_sid, direct_source). Source URLs and storage paths are never exposed.

unixTime.description: Unix time in seconds as a decimal string, at most ten digits (milliseconds are a bug).

count.description: A non-negative count as a decimal string.

positiveCount.description: A positive count as a decimal string.

flag.description: A PHP boolean as a string: "0" or "1".

flagInt.description: A PHP boolean as an integer: 0 or 1.

port.description: A TCP port as a decimal string.

xcId.description: An Xtream integer id (xc_id): stream_id, series_id. One sequence is shared by movies, episodes and live channels.

xcIdString.description: An Xtream integer id written as a decimal string (episode id, EPG listing id).

num.description: 1-based position of the item in this response.

categoryId.description: A category id as a decimal string.

categoryIds.description: Every category of the item that the user can see, as integers; the first is category_id.

imageUrl.description: An absolute http(s) URL of a JPEG, PNG or WebP image, or "". Never a relative path or storage key, never AVIF or SVG (TV apps cannot decode them).

imageUrlList.description: backdrop_path: always an array of absolute image URLs, [] when there is none.

rating.description: A 0-10 rating as a decimal string ("8.2"), or "" when unrated.

rating5.description: The rating on a 0-5 scale as a JSON number (rating / 2, one decimal); 0 when unrated.

date.description: A calendar date YYYY-MM-DD, or "" when unknown.

dateTime.description: A UTC date and time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (server_info.timezone is UTC).

durationSecs.description: A running time in whole seconds.

bitrate.description: The average bitrate of the delivered file in kbit/s.

minutes.description: A running time in minutes as a decimal string, or "".

tmdbId.description: A TMDB id as a decimal string, or "" for titles without one.

youtubeKey.description: A YouTube video id (11 characters), never a URL: apps build the watch URL themselves. "" when there is no trailer.

containerExtension.description: The extension apps append to the play URL. Movies and episodes always play the compatible MP4 rendition.

epgChannelId.description: The XMLTV channel id, or "" when the channel has no guide. No whitespace or quotes: it is also the M3U tvg-id.

video.description: Summary of the delivered video stream. Always an object, never [].

audio.description: Summary of the first delivered audio track. Always an object, never []; a file without audio has codec_name "" and channels 0.

category.description: One entry of get_vod_categories, get_series_categories or get_live_categories.

category_name.description: In the user's locale (ar or en).

parent_id.description: Always 0: IPTV apps show categories as a flat list.

categoryList.description: The categories the user's plan allows, ordered by sort. [] when there is none, never {}.

base64Text.description: UTF-8 text encoded with standard base64 (EPG title and description).

epgListing.description: One programme in get_short_epg or get_simple_data_table.

epg_id.description: The id of the EPG source, as a decimal string.

lang.description: ISO 639-1/2 language code of the title, or "".

has_archive.description: 1 when the programme can be played from catch-up (timeshift).

epgResponse.description: The EPG payload of get_short_epg and get_simple_data_table.

epg_listings.description: Programmes ordered by start time; [] when the channel has no guide.
